description: Filter Bar Plume puts several slicers in a single compact visual. Drop up to 8 columns in Fields and a COUNTROWS measure in Count: each field becomes a dropdown menu with search and counts, and every active filter becomes a removable chip. It saves page space, keeps all filters in one place and reads well on phones. FREE, NO WATERMARK • 1 to 3 fields per bar • Horizontal bar of dropdowns or vertical panel of expandable sections • Faceted counts: each count takes into account the choices made in the other fields • Search in every list, three-state "Select all", single-selection fields (radio buttons) • Sort values by label, by count or in model order; values that became empty dimmed, hidden or kept • Active filter chips, "Clear all" button and total after filters ("→ 10,960 orders") • Collapsed mode below a chosen width: a "Filters (n)" button opens a full-frame panel • Bookmarks and sync slicers restore every filter of the bar • Keyboard navigation (arrows between fields and values, Space, Esc), screen readers, high contrast, themes, English and French • Custom colors: background, text, grid, accent, favorable / unfavorable, 8 series and a 3-color gradient; Minimal and Black & White styles PREMIUM (★, additional purchase) • 4 to 8 fields in the same bar • Apply button: tick values in several fields, then filter the report with a single query (pending changes and Cancel) •…
